entries.head: promql
entries.rationale: The HTTP query entry points handle scalar and string constants before vector lowering; the parser does not produce StepInvariantExpr. The remaining parsed expression types are the explicit cases in lower's type switch, including matrix selectors. Recursive callers forward already parsed, position-typechecked vector operands, not new AST variants. The math callers now enter through lowerMathOperand, which passes the same original vector argument to lower before checking the resulting plan's policy; this does not widen the input vocabulary. Root and operand policy wrappers authorize existing dispatch branches and preserve their arguments. Neither the policy wrappers nor the math adapter creates a wire path to this default. The sort caller lowerSortFloatOperand forwards the same original parsed vector argument before consulting an existing-plan payload policy; it creates no new AST variant. The mixed-or float-arm caller lowerMixedFloatArm forwards the same original parsed float operand to lower when no mixed recognizer claims it; it creates no new AST variant. The predict_linear caller lowerCallOverSubquery passes lower the constant empty vector emptyInstantVector builds, a BinaryExpr over a vector() call and a NumberLiteral, which the type switch's explicit cases cover.

guard: default of switch e := expr.(type) over [case *parser.VectorSelector; case *parser.Call; case *parser.AggregateExpr; case *parser.ParenExpr; case *parser.BinaryExpr; case *parser.SubqueryExpr; case *parser.MatrixSelector; case *parser.UnaryExpr; default]
